title: fix: technician availability showing wrong times for EST users
body:
## Summary
Users in Eastern time were seeing available slots shifted by an hour during daylight saving time. The `get_available_slots` function was using a fixed UTC-5 offset instead of the timezone-aware `America/New_York` zone.

This fixes it by using `zoneinfo.ZoneInfo` throughout the availability calculation pipeline.

## Test plan
- Manual testing with EST/EDT user accounts
- Added regression test for the DST boundary case

commits.messageHeadline: fix: use ZoneInfo instead of fixed UTC offset for availability
test: add DST boundary regression test
